notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
A first big update after the release! Lots of things fixed, more to come tommorow.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Features
[list]
[*]Rally Points - now you can set rally points for produced units
[*]Improved tutorial
[*]You can now switch overlays using TAB button
[*]Balance tweaks
[*]Small UI tweaks
[/list]
[*]Lots of bugfixes and stability improvements
[list]
[*]Fixed click exploit
[*]"Click A button" appearing after selecting keyboard/mouse as primary device
[*]Lots of minor bugs
[/list]
[/list]

More to come in the next update!

notes.title: Version 0.9.10-BETA
notes.notes:
This updates focuses mainly on UI and usability improvements.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]New overlays:
[list]
[*]Resources - shows buildings with scavengable resources
[*]People - shows people that are hiding in buildings and can be rescued
[*]Structure integrity - shows health of the buildings
[/list]
[*]Weather forecast is shown during the mission selection. It will help users with their faction configuration.
[*]Improved building info screen
[*]During mission you will be able to see what kind of forces are gaining penalties from weather
[*]Ordering group to move in one point is now makes them scatter a little
[*]Added simple screen with mouse/keyboard controls
[*]New animations for smoke, acid and support weapons.
[*]Bugfixes and balance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: First beta keys sent and version 0.9.5-BETA released
notes.notes:
Time to start showing our game to the world!

We've sent some keys to youtube/twitch players and eagerly waiting for first feedback!

If you'll find any issues - fell free to mail us to mailbox@mozglabs.com and we'll fix them.

Thanks!
